trail_rations.name: Trail Rations
trail_rations.description: Dried meat, hardtack, and a waterskin — enough to keep you going for a day. (5 SP)

healing_potion.name: Healing Potion
healing_potion.description: A vial of red liquid that magically heals wounds when drunk.

cloak_of_protection.name: Cloak of Protection
cloak_of_protection.description: A shimmering cloak that subtly deflects harm.

rapier.name: Rapier
rapier.description: A slender, elegant thrusting sword favored by duelists.

dagger.name: Dagger
dagger.description: A short blade, useful for close work. (20 SP)

dart.name: Dart
dart.description: A light throwing dart with an iron needle tip. (5 CP)

leather_armor.name: Leather Armor
leather_armor.description: Supple, lightweight armor made from tanned hide.

chain_mail.name: Chain Mail
chain_mail.description: Interlocked metal rings providing solid protection.

torch.name: Torch
torch.description: Burns for 1 hour, casting bright light in a 20-foot radius. (1 CP)

rope.name: Rope (50 ft)
rope.description: Fifty feet of hempen rope. (10 SP)

thieves_tools.name: Thieves' Tools
thieves_tools.description: A set of lockpicks and other tools for bypassing locks.

lute.name: Lute
lute.description: A finely crafted stringed instrument favored by bards.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: A wooden or metal shield that adds +2 to AC.

component_pouch.name: Component Pouch
component_pouch.description: A belt pouch containing material components for spells.

mace.name: Mace
mace.description: A flanged metal weapon favored by clerics.

handaxe.name: Handaxe
handaxe.description: A light, versatile woodcutter's axe suitable for close-quarters combat.

quarterstaff.name: Quarterstaff
quarterstaff.description: A simple wooden staff carried by travelers and spellcasters alike.

shortbow.name: Shortbow
shortbow.description: A small recurve bow designed for hunting and skirmishing.

scale_mail.name: Scale Mail
scale_mail.description: Armor made of overlapping metal scales fastened to leather backing.

spellbook.name: Spellbook
spellbook.description: A leather-bound tome inscribed with arcane formula and incantations.

holy_symbol.name: Holy Symbol
holy_symbol.description: A sacred medallion channel for divine spellcasting.

cursed_ring_of_burden.name: Ring of the Burdened
cursed_ring_of_burden.description: A cursed ring that feels heavy on the finger, penalizing the wearer's defenses.

cursed_berserker_axe.name: Berserker Axe
cursed_berserker_axe.description: An axe cursed with blinding fury that refuses to leave its wielder's grip.

raw_food.name: Raw Food
raw_food.description: Fresh uncooked food provisions. Spoils in 5 days if not cooked or eaten. (1 SP)

raw_meat.name: Raw Meat
raw_meat.description: Freshly butchered game meat. Lasts 5 days before spoiling. (2 SP)

wild_vegetables.name: Wild Vegetables
wild_vegetables.description: Foraged roots, greens, and mushrooms. Lasts 5 days before spoiling. (1 SP)

rotten_food.name: Rotten Food
rotten_food.description: Spoiled, rancid food. Cooking with this causes food poisoning without a DC 13 Constitution save.

hearty_stew.name: Hearty Stew
hearty_stew.description: A thick, steaming bowl of savory camp stew. Provides +5 temporary HP and relieves exhaustion. (5 SP)

herbs.name: Medicinal Herbs
herbs.description: Fragrant dried herbs used for brewing tonics and treating ailments. (10 SP)

rations.name: Rations
rations.description: Preserved food rations suitable for a journey. (4 SP)

antitoxin.name: Antitoxin
antitoxin.description: A small vial of bitter liquid that cures the poisoned condition.

potion_of_invisibility.name: Potion of Invisibility
potion_of_invisibility.description: Drinking this potion confers invisibility for 10 rounds or until you attack.

potion_of_speed.name: Potion of Speed
potion_of_speed.description: A swirling yellow elixir that grants +2 AC and rapid reflexes.

boots_of_elvenkind.name: Boots of Elvenkind
boots_of_elvenkind.description: Soft leather boots that muffle your footsteps completely.

ring_of_protection.name: Ring of Protection
ring_of_protection.description: A polished silver ring that hums with abjuration magic. +1 AC and +1 to all saves.

silvered_dagger.name: Silvered Dagger
silvered_dagger.description: A dagger plated with pure silver, effective against supernatural beasts.

silvered_longsword.name: Silvered Longsword
silvered_longsword.description: A finely forged longsword coated in gleaming silver to cut through supernatural hides.
